note: This suite could not run at all until 2026-08-29 -- the module would not install -- and first measured 29 failures of 401. Five cross-repo drifts accounted for 25 of them, all now fixed: PAGE_BREAK and _BARCODE_READERS moved to document_extract.tools.readers; TERMINAL_SAT_STATES was deleted outright from enterprise l10n_mx_edi; account.tax replaced company_id with company_ids, a many2many, which _find_tax and _get_tax_domain still filtered in the singular -- that was LIVE product code, not test debt, so CFDI tax matching was broken in production; and _enqueue_phase passed delayed(description=) where the API has only ever taken name=. The four that remain are individual, not a pattern: a tax group whose country_id must match its tax, a SAT-unreachable fixture, and two column-tuple assertions.
